candidates.statement: Order service is the failing hop: checkout span errors at 1650ms, order error_rate 0.24 with p95 520ms, and 9 unhandled_request_failure 500s in order logs, while payment and gateway stay healthy (error_rate 0.001, p95 70ms, 200/ok).
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record (order 3.0.0, 3 min old) does not by itself establish deployment-caused failure; no db_pool_waiters or dependency_timeouts observed.

report.explanation: Order is the only degraded service: erroring checkout span, 24% error rate, elevated p95, and 500-level unhandled failures. Payment and gateway are healthy, so the bounded root cause is order-side HTTP 500 failures; the specific internal defect is not yet established.
